subject: SDE2 offer — RSU conversion and payout timing clarification
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SDE2 offer — RSU conversion and payout timing clarification

Team,

We have a candidate (Alex Roberts) for SDE2; recruiting has negotiated a slightly non-standard RSU schedule due to his pre-IPO rollover. Quick summary of the proposed package (see attached draft and comp band spreadsheet):

- Base: $155,000 (within band)
- Target bonus: 12% (annual)
- RSU: 36,000 RSUs (market-level grant for SDE2) broken into two parts: 30,000 standard 4-year vesting (25% cliff at 12 months, then quarterly) + 6,000 sign-on RSUs that recruiting proposes to accelerate.
- Proposed sign-on vesting: 50% of the 6,000 vests at 6 months, remaining 50% vests at 12 months (one-time acceleration to help with equity rollover cashflow).

Ask: do we have approval to (A) make the 6,000 RSU sign-on accelerated as described, and (B) issue the offer with the base/bonus above? This deviates from our usual model where sign-ons follow the standard 4-year schedule.

Risk notes: accelerated RSUs increase near-term dilution and may set expectations, but the candidate has a competing cash-heavy comp package. Marcus, as hiring manager, please confirm the business case. Markus/Neha — need compensation sign-off to proceed to DocuSign by EOD today (we're aiming to close before candidate's counter-deadline).

Attachments: Alex_Roberts_Offer_Draft.pdf, Comp_Bands_Q3_2027.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDE2 offer — RSU conversion and payout timing clarification

Laura — thanks for the clear summary.

Business perspective: Alex will own a core infra feature set and is time-sensitive; losing him will set back launch timelines by an estimated 3-4 months. I support a one-time acceleration, but prefer limiting the accelerated portion to a small chunk (the 6k suggested feels OK). Two quick asks:

1) Can we keep the majority (30k) on standard schedule? Yes.
2) For the accelerated tranche, recommend a 6-month cliff for the first half and the remainder at 12 months (matches what recruiting proposed).

If compensation signs off, I'm green to extend the offer.

Subject: Re: SDE2 offer — RSU conversion and payout timing clarification

Thanks — reviewed against comp bands. Approvals below: 

- Base $155,000: APPROVED (within band for SDE2, no exceptions).
- Target bonus 12%: APPROVED.
- RSU total 36,000: APPROVED in band.
- Acceleration of 6,000 sign-on RSUs: APPROVED as an exception with guardrails:
  * 6,000 sign-on RSUs split 3,000 vests after 6 months, 3,000 vests at 12 months (one-time exception).
  * Add a note in the offer: accelerated sign-on grant is contingent on start date within 6 weeks of offer acceptance (to limit open-ended expectations).
  * This exception should be recorded in the comp exceptions tracker (I'll update).

Please proceed to HR for offer generation and route via DocuSign. Marcus, Laura — confirm if you want compensation to include a short clause describing standard post-12mo vesting schedule for the remaining 30,000.

Date: 2027-07-25T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final — SDE2 offer approved, route to DocuSign

Thanks all — per Neha's guidance we're good to send. Final directions for HR Ops: 

1) Issue offer with: Base $155,000 | Target bonus 12% | RSU 36,000 total
2) RSU vesting language: 30,000 standard 4-year vesting (25% at 12 months then quarterly); 6,000 sign-on RSUs: 3,000 vests at 6 months, 3,000 at 12 months. Include the contingency that the accelerated sign-on vests only if start date is within six weeks of acceptance.
3) Attach the comp band snapshot and include the one-line exception note in the offer cover sheet.
4) Send the finalized offer via DocuSign to alex.roberts@gmail.com (link above). Please confirm once envelope is sent.

Alex — cc'd so you have a sense of timing. We'll route this now and confirm once sent.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
